tool.name: MicrobiomeProfiler
tool.description: Interactive functional enrichment analysis of microbiome data
tool.command: exec R --vanilla -q -e "suppressMessages(library(MicrobiomeProfiler)) ; app <- MicrobiomeProfiler::run_MicrobiomeProfiler() ; shiny::runApp(app, host = '0.0.0.0', port = 8080, launch.browser = FALSE)"

param.name: input_table
param.label: Annotation table
param.help: Tab separated table of microbial gene annotations with a gene identifier column (KEGG KO, or a column you map to one in the app). Pre-uploading it is convenient but not required - the app can also fetch and cache datasets itself.

tool.help:
`MicrobiomeProfiler <https://github.com/yulab-smu/microbiomeprofiler>`_ is an R package and Shiny application for functional enrichment analysis in microbiome studies, built on the `clusterProfiler` ecosystem.
.. class:: infomark
**This tool needs internet access while it is running.** Enrichment is performed against live services - KEGG REST (`rest.kegg.jp`), eggNOG, SMPDB, Disbiome and HMDB - so the container has to be able to reach them. Annotation resources that ship with the package are available offline.
Supported workflows:
#. KEGG enrichment and GSEA for microbiome gene profiles #. COG enrichment and GSEA #. eggNOG-based KEGG pathway enrichment and GSEA #. Microbe-disease enrichment with Disbiome #. Microbial signature enrichment with BugSigDB #. Metabolite pathway enrichment with HMDB and SMPDB #. Interactive exploration with tables, dotplots and barplots
.. class:: infomark
**Results are downloaded from the browser.** Every module has its own download buttons; nothing is written into the Galaxy history.
.. class:: infomark
**Citation**
Yu G (2024). MicrobiomeProfiler: An R package for microbiome functional enrichment analysis. Journal of Open Source Software.
